subject: ModuleHost answer, onboarding events, fixtures for one-state scope
body: D-experience-003 is now accepted on my branch. ModuleHost (proposed D-experience-005): {el?: HTMLElement, speech: {speak(text): Promise<void>, listen(onText(t, final)): unsubscribe, muted}, clock: {now(), speed}, onSafetyStop(reason)}. Please put the onboarding event union in API.md: guideTurn, userTurn, stateNamed, stepCaptured, submodalityCaptured, contrastCaptured, driverFound, anchorStepMarked, testRated, confirmed, stopped. Fixtures I need for the one-state scope: a Profile v2 with states[1] and ordered steps (Ve -> Ai -> Ki) with submodalities, contrast, drivers and anchorStep; a scripted onboarding event stream of about 90 s; peak and contrast calibration; and rep-log.demo.json.
